title: fix: push STABILITY_API_KEY to the gen worker
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: `stability-ai/stable-audio-3` fails with "missing STABILITY_API_KEY" because the secret never reached the gen worker.
- #11912 added `STABILITY_API_KEY` to `gen.pollinations.ai/secrets/*.vars.json`, but not to the push allowlist in `push-generation-secrets.mjs`, so every deploy dropped it.
- Adds it to `REQUIRED_SECRET_KEYS`. The value is unchanged and already present in prod, staging and dev.
- Live workers checked (names only): neither `pollinations-gen-production` nor `pollinations-gen-staging` has it. The stored key is valid with the Stability API.
- Secret addition approved for staging and production.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Aj15m1tbSVxFnVTaHpqi3X

gist.headline: The audio key finds its way
gist.blurb: Stable Audio 3 had a key; the gen worker just wasn't receiving it. One allowlist entry gives the music a way through.
gist.summary: Added `STABILITY_API_KEY` to the gen worker's `REQUIRED_SECRET_KEYS` push allowlist so deployments pass the existing secret to `stability-ai/stable-audio-3`.
gist.impact: Stable Audio 3 requests can authenticate with Stability instead of failing with `missing STABILITY_API_KEY`.
